latest.title: Google Home Is Going Agentic Via Integration With The MCP Standard - Engadget
latest.summary: # Google Home is going agentic via integration with the MCP standard. Premium Advanced users will get an early access build "in the coming weeks.". Google Home is getting support for the Model Context...
highlights: # Google Home is going agentic via integration with the MCP standard. Premium Advanced users will get an early access build "in the coming weeks.". Google Home is getting support for the Model Context Protocol (MCP) standard. This means that users will be able to use a variety of AI agents to complete smart home tasks, as MCP is a software platform that lets agentic chatbots connect to external APIs. Supported agents include Google Antigravity, Claude, Hermes and Open Claw, among others. Google says the integration will let these agents "securely work with all of the devices and event history in your Google Home ecosystem.". Google says an early access build will arrive in the "coming weeks." However, it'll only be available to Google Home Premium Advanced users for now. Anthropic introduced MCP back in 2024 and it's become somewhat popular in the past year or so. Google, OpenAI, Microsoft and SpaceXAI all support it in some form and many applications plug in neatly.

highlights: # Google Home is going agentic via integration with the MCP standard. Premium Advanced users will get an early access build "in the coming weeks.". Google Home is getting support for the Model Context Protocol (MCP) standard.
